Guidance & outlook: And we are targeting that this ratio should be minimum 50-50%, so that we can establish ourselves as a reliable expert company in case of power sector.
It is under testing and we are confident that 90% results of this product is already proven.
So with that kind of growth, we are seeing about 12 to 14% of CAGR and anticipated growth of about $110 billion by 2030 as far as the India market is concerned.
Growth & demand: On the standalone basis, FY '26 revenue grew 26.8% to 97.08 crore, and standalone PAT was 12.56 crore, up to above 9%.
On consolidated basis, revenue was 97.24 crore, up 27%, while the consolidated PAT was 6.07 crore.
Growth bhi hai, 27% growth bhi hai year to year, theek hai.
Margins & costs: On that footing, we are guiding to 30% CAGR in revenue, EBITDA, and PAT over the next three years on consolidated basis.
And like your EBITDA standalone EBITDA margin also experienced a dip from 25 to 21% despite of the growing revenue.
One is in December 2025 concall, you alluded to a growth of about 200% and you also said that our margins will be stable.
Capex & expansion: This is the direct result of deliberate upfront investment into our semiconductor subsidiary and our international buildup in UAE.
So they have PCBA plant, EMS plant, mechanical wiring harness, what not.

But we were lagging onto the manufacturing up till now and I think the government of India has taken the strong lead in last couple of years by approving thousands of crores for, you know, investing into OSAT plant to start with for six to seven major companies and one among them is Kaynes Semicon of course.
